subject: Reschedule request: Helio customer tour demo — options and recording
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helio.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Customer tour conflict — need to move our demo?

Hi Diego,

Quick heads up: our Helio customer tour shifted a few on-site meetings and two members of our evaluation committee (including our Director of Security) will now be traveling on the day we had the demo scheduled (Oct 20, 11:00 PDT).

Would it be possible to move the session to Oct 21 (same time) or Oct 22 morning? If changing is too disruptive we could also request a recording or have one of your SEs lead a recording/live session asynchronously that we can review with the team.

We'd prefer to keep the demo live if possible, but travel is tight. Can you let me know what works?

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Turner
Senior Program Manager | Helio Therapeutics
alyssa.turner@helio.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Note: We’ll have Carlos Mendes (DevOps) on the call if possible; he’s flexible but prefers afternoons PST.

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Customer tour conflict — need to move our demo?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand the travel squeeze.

Two options that should be straightforward on our end:
- Move the live demo to Wed, Oct 21 at 11:00 PDT (same agenda) — Marissa (cc) can run it.
- Move to Thu, Oct 22 at 09:00 PDT if earlier in the day is better.

If neither slot works, we can record the session and share an edited 20–30 minute version plus the full raw recording for internal review. We can also do a short live Q&A (15 minutes) the following week for any security-specific follow-ups.

I've attached the proposed updated agenda (Helio-demo-agenda-v1.pdf) so you can confirm the scope if we switch dates. If you confirm Oct 21 at 11:00 PDT I’ll send the calendar invite and include Carlos.

Let me know which you prefer and whether we should include a note on the invite to hold space for a recording distribution.

Best,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0123

Attachment: Helio-demo-agenda-v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Customer tour conflict — need to move our demo?

Hi all — I can absolutely cover and run the live walkthrough on Wed, Oct 21 at 11:00 PDT. If you do end up preferring a recording, I can produce a staged 25-minute recording that hits the architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, and the dedicated/private deployment options; Monica can prep the short ops appendix for the security team.

Logistics I can handle if you want a recording:
- I’ll bring a short script and capture a live run-through.
- We can supply an edited 20–25 minute version + raw MP4.
- We typically deliver recordings and supporting slides to a shared Drive folder and include a short README for who to send to internally.

I’ve attached our internal recording checklist (recording-instructions.pdf) for transparency.

If Oct 21 works, Diego — could you add Carlos to the calendar invite and mark the event as "virtual + recording allowed" so we capture everything in case some folks are still traveling?

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: recording-instructions.pdf

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@helio.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@helio.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Customer tour conflict — need to move our demo?

Perfect — Oct 21 at 11:00 PDT works for us.

Please go ahead and send the updated calendar invite with Marissa as the presenter and Carlos added; I’ll also add our Director of Security (Juliana Park) as optional — she’s traveling but will try to dial in. If anything changes on our side I’ll give you at least 4 hours notice.

Also, please share the recording after the session — if Juliana misses it she’ll want to review.

Thanks for the flexibility!
Alyssa
